conventions: +Y up, +Z forward, +X the figure's left; pose = local quaternion relative to rest (skeleton.json); frame layout as in clips.json
skin_matrix: 3 rows x 4 floats [R | t], t = p - R * restHead (inverseBind = translate(-head)), 3 texels per bone (RGBA)
bone_texture: rows = frames, columns = 3 * bones; bones = lod.mid.bones (36) or all (61)
vat: texel = frame * nvPad + vertex, RGB = position
hash: FNV-1a 32 over the float32 bytes of the baked clip
